title: Sign in
panelText: Money, sheets, players, prices, workers and settings. Only Aqil and Adil can sign in here.
private: Private address. You opened {{address}}. Workers don’t have this link and the counter screen never shows it. Keep it to yourselves.
keepComputer: Keep me signed in on this computer
keepPhone: Keep me signed in on this phone
forgot: Forgot the password? The other owner can set a new one in Settings. After 5 wrong tries, sign-in waits 15 minutes.
forgotPhone: This is the private owner address. Forgot the password? The other owner can set a new one in Settings.
